dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Some troops told me recently that there are some ore mining veins around here.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: That said, though, I'm not really convinced of the quality of anything that isn't Jade Steel.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: I'd put them as having been around here, and I'll help you mark them out. Go check them out if you're interested.
